description: Update a note's title, content, tags, or notebook, or move/tag a batch with guids. addTags/removeTags are additive (missing names are created). replacements[] is a find-and-replace patch that keeps attachments. Modes are mutually exclusive.

addTags.description: Tags to add without removing others (names or GUIDs). Missing names are created.

createNotebook.description: Create notebookName if it does not exist (default: false).

forceUpdate.description: DESTRUCTIVE: If true and update fails due to edit lock, DELETES the original note and creates a replacement. The note GUID will change, note history will be lost, and timestamps will reset. Only use as a last resort after confirming with the user.

forceUpdateConfirmation.description: Required when forceUpdate is true. Must be the exact string "I understand this will delete the original note" to proceed.

guid.description: Single note GUID (mutually exclusive with guids)

guids.description: Batch of note GUIDs, max 25 (mutually exclusive with guid). Only notebookName, addTags, and removeTags are allowed.

notebookName.description: Move the note(s) to this existing notebook. Unknown names are rejected with close matches unless createNotebook is true.

removeTags.description: Tags to remove without touching others (names or GUIDs).

replacements.description: Patch mode: find-and-replace operations to apply. Mutually exclusive with title/content/tags/notebookName.

tags.description: New tags, replacing existing tags (full-update mode). Mutually exclusive with addTags/removeTags.

name: evernote_update_note
title: Update note
